analysis.method: Offline decoded-waveform RMS, local transient/spectral-flux periodicity, and ffmpeg EBU R128 loudness analysis.
analysis.phraseAlignment: Actual decoded duration is authoritative; fractional loopBeats expresses an approximate visual tempo, not an integer phrase or verified seamless loop.
analysis.downbeatNotes: Estimated recurring attack phase in the opening 30 seconds. This is not a verified musical downbeat; timing can drift in generated recordings.
analysis.cueNotes: Broad signal-derived eight-second RMS energy cues only. break/build/drop and kickOn are visual heuristics, not verified section names or isolated percussion detection.
analysis.beatMethod: high-band positive spectral-flux fallback after weak low-band periodicity
analysis.envelopeNormalization: 100 ms stereo RMS from the final decoded MP3, divided by its 95th percentile and clamped to [0,1].

tracks.title: Arabic Nights
tracks.description: A rolling house groove with a warm, winding melodic line.
tracks.attribution: "Arabic Nights" by Nemphirex. Source: https://soundcloud.com/nemphirex/nemphirex-arabic-nights . Licensed under CC BY 3.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
tracks.changes: A 64-second / 128-beat excerpt from 64.000–128.000 seconds; constant gain loudness matching to approximately -16 LUFS; 4 ms edge fades; re-encoded as 160 kbps stereo MP3 for looping game playback. No EQ, pitch or tempo changes.

analysis.method: Offline decoded-waveform, loudness and transient analysis of the owner-approved preview source window
analysis.phraseAlignment: 128 tempo-grid beats from the approved preview entrance; harmonic seam has not been manually auditioned.
analysis.downbeatNotes: Repeated 120 BPM low-frequency attack phase estimated computationally; musical bar identity is not manually verified.
analysis.cueNotes: Section labels are broad signal-derived cues. The Naan excerpt energy falls substantially in its last eight seconds; Arabic Nights keeps a steady groove.
analysis.envelopeNormalization: 50 ms stereo RMS of the final MP3, normalized to its 95th percentile and clamped to [0,1].
